stance_basis: letter explicitly states no comments on the project
summary: Frank W. Chesrow, as Chairman of the Cook County Planning Commission, submitted a letter on behalf of the Department of Planning and Development stating that after appropriate consultation, the department had no comments on NIPC project 74-228 (among others) submitted for review under OMB Circular A-95. His communication neither supports nor opposes the Lincoln Highway widening project, simply indicating no objection or concern.
complaint_summary: The Cook County Planning Commission's Department of Planning and Development states it has no comments on NIPC 74-228 (Lincoln Highway widening) and several other projects submitted for A-95 review.
